title: Structure and properties of tubular structures based on the quaternary misfit layered compound Sm1−xYxS–TaS2
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9605-9617
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00780A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Simon Hettler, Mohammad Furqan, M. B. Sreedhara, Azat Khadiev, Reshef Tenne, Raul Arenal
Nanotubes made of the quaternary misfit layered compound Sm1−xYxS–TaS2 have been synthesized using the chemical vapour technique. Imaging, diffraction and spectroscopy shed light on their structure and properties.
